|lore=Designed as a response to the threat of Imperial espionage droids. Joins a droid pool and uncovers spies. Has tattoo reading 'Thank The Maker' on left posterior plating.
|game_text=Once each turn, during your control phase, for each opponent's spy present opponent must lose 1 Force (2 if spy is a droid or is Undercover, 4 if both).
|joke="Left posterior plating" is the droid's backside, so the lore gives a prim protocol droid a tattoo on his bottom. Before the card, tattoos on the backside were a running joke about the singer Cher: her tattooed buttocks showed in her 1989 video for "If I Could Turn Back Time",<ref name="b13-wp-itcbt">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If_I_Could_Turn_Back_Time If I Could Turn Back Time], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164614/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If_I_Could_Turn_Back_Time Internet Archive], 12 October 2026.</ref> and in the 1993 video for "I Got You Babe" with Cher, Butt-Head of MTV's ''Beavis and Butt-Head'' says "We need a chick that's got tattoos on her butt".<ref name="b14-latimes-bb">[https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-11-14-ca-56606-story.html Cher Gets Cheeky With Beavis and Butt-head], ''Los Angeles Times'' (14 November 1993). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260424224139/https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-11-14-ca-56606-story.html Internet Archive], 24 April 2026.</ref> The tattoo is C-3PO's catchphrase "Thank the maker!" from ''Star Wars'',<ref name="imsdb-anh">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Star Wars: A New Hope script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260720032511/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-A-New-Hope.html Internet Archive], 20 July 2026.</ref> the title of the [[Premiere]] card [[Thank The Maker]]. See [[Jokes#R-3PO|Jokes]].
